study type: Randomized controlled experimental animal model study
cohort: Twenty-nine Macaca nemestrina (non-human primates) were randomized to control or umbilical cord occlusion, with or without therapeutic hypothermia and erythropoietin.
finding: Baseline injury severity was the single best predictor of death/cerebral palsy, and the addition of biomarker data (circulating chemokines) did not improve the ability to predict outcomes.
